name: ultrapowers
description: The turns of an issue-to-pull-request agent flow, as prompts on top of superpowers: draft the spec, plan once it is approved, build the plan a task at a time, answer failed checks and reviews, review the change with a security pass by a subagent, assess a bug and build its fix once the report is approved, carry an issue through its sub-issues, and follow up a Renovate pull request.
